before: A formatting change on text and its paragraph mark lists two decisions. Single decisions on formatting inside another change, on one move or vertical merge half, or on a deleted paragraph or row that holds another author's change, refuse. The visible bulk decision leaves table property history.
after: Contiguous formatting changes by one author list one decision. A single or named decision resolves nested changes, whole moves and merges, the changes inside the content it removes, one changed cell of a row, and a merge head whose continuation row is deleted; accepting a deletion of a whole cell removes the cell in any decision order; rejecting an inserted cell and its neighbour's width change decide together; an alignment-only table change lists with the row and cell changes of its table, stays pending after a cell decision, and its rejection keeps the current alignment in rows without such changes; a change ends at the edge of a content control, hyperlink, simple field, or direction wrapper, and at an unchanged field character; changes in comment text list and resolve; a content lock keeps only the decisions that change what a control holds; a decision that empties a control restores its placeholder, moves an emptied block control inline, joins equal tables left side by side, and removes an emptied equation; a decision that would remove one half of another move refuses; filtered decisions resolve nested changes they keep. Collections list tracked cells, merges, and numbering. The visible bulk decision without a filter clears table property history. A decided row exception keeps only what differs from the table properties, before the row properties. Inserted or deleted cells in one column of adjacent rows list as one change; a moved mark outside its move range lists with its text and rejecting it removes the mark; the same paragraph property change continues into the next cell of a row. Inside a locked control a nested change the lock allows resolves on its own; a nested table whose text a reject removes goes with its inserted row; an emptied custom XML block goes whole.
reason: Each replica derives the review queue from the shared tree, and decisions emit the existing revision resolution operations. Shared nodes, text offsets, operation kinds, and package serialization are unchanged.
